Gutachten.en: European Parliament, European Parliament, European Parliament

texto: When in a main sentence there are several nouns with different genres (* der Gutachter *, * die Akte *, * das Protokoll *), the relative pronoun points to precisely which of them the subordinate clarification refers:

filas: Das ist der Sachverständige, dem die Richterin vertraut.
Er prüfte die Akte, in der wichtige Daten fehlen.
Sie las das Gutachten, das neue Indizien aufdeckt.
auf die sich die Klage stützt
Das sind Aussagen, auf die sich die Klage stützt.

texto: In Spanish, turns like «the report of the committee that was adopted yesterday» raise doubts as to whether the report or the commission was approved. In German, the explicit gender concordance of the relative (**das** for * das Gutachten *, **die** for * die Kommission *) removes all interpretative ambiguity from the root.

bloques.titulo: Vocabulary: expert procedure and documentary analysis

frases.de: Wir prüfen heute das Gutachten des Sachverständigen, das die Verteidigung vorgelegt hat.
frases.es: Hoy examinamos el informe pericial del perito que ha presentado la defensa.
frases.en: Today we are examining the expert report of the defence expert.

frases.de: Meinen Sie das Gutachten oder den Sachverständigen, den die Gegenseite geladen hat?
frases.es: ¿Se refiere al dictamen o al perito al que ha citado la parte contraria?
frases.en: Does it refer to the opinion or expert to whom the contrary party has referred?
analisis: to which the other party has referred

frases.de: Ich beziehe mich auf das Gutachten, in dem mehrere Berechnungsfehler vorliegen.
frases.es: Me refiero al dictamen, en el que existen varios errores de cálculo.
frases.en: I am referring to the opinion, in which there are a number of miscalculations.
analisis: where there are several errors in calculation

frases.de: Gut. Hier liegt auch die Zeugenaussage, an die wir uns halten müssen.
frases.es: Bien. Aquí está también la declaración del testigo a la que debemos atenernos.
frases.en: Good. Here is also the statement of the witness to which we must be attached.
analisis: an die wir uns halten müssen

bloques.pregunta: In the «Wir prüfen das Gutachten des Sachverständigen, das die Verteidigung vorgelegt hat» sentence, to which element does the relative to «das» change?

opciones.texto: It modifies «das Gutachten» (neutral), as the relative pronoun «das» is gender and number in line with the opinion and not with the expert («der Sachverständige»).
opciones.explicacion: The gender distinction makes it clear that what was presented is the expert's expertise and not the person of the expert.

opciones.texto: Modifica a «der Sachverständige», porque los peritos siempre concuerdan en neutro cuando elaboran informes.
opciones.explicacion: Personal masculine nouns never adopt neutral pronoun in relative prayers.

opciones.texto: Modifica al abogado que suscribe el acta de la sesión judicial.
opciones.explicacion: The lawyer does not appear as an immediate antecedent or share gender with «das».

bloques.frase: Die Kanzlei vertritt die Zeugin, ___ der Richter eine offizielle Aussage verlangt hat.

opciones.explicacion: «verlangen von» rules dative and «die Zeugin» is antecedent feminine singular.
«von dem» would indicate a masculine or neutral antecedent, incompatible with «die Zeugin».
«von denen» is a plural dative and the phrase is a single witness.

bloques.pregunta: What is the exact interpretation of the reference?
bloques.frase: Er überreichte dem Vorsitzenden die Akte, die alle entscheidenden Indizien enthielt.

opciones.texto: He handed over to the president of the court the file containing all the decisive signs.
opciones.explicacion: The relative feminine «die» refers unambiguously to «die Akte» (file) and not to the president («der Vorsitzende»).

opciones.texto: He handed over to the president of the court, who was the person who contained all the evidence.
opciones.explicacion: It would merge the reference: «die» is feminine and points to the documentary folder, not to Judge masculine.

opciones.texto: He requested a new file to file the uncompleted testimony of the witnesses.
opciones.explicacion: The action expressed by «überreichte» is the material delivery of the documentation, not your file request.

bloques.frase: Das Gericht würdigte die Indizien, auf ___ die Anklage aufbaute.

opciones.explicacion: «auf» with «aufbauen» in a figurative sense of being based on plural acstrative rule («auf die Indizien»).
«das» is neutral singular, incompatible with the «die Indizien» plural antecedent.
«denen» is plural dative, while the construction demands accusative with «auf».

bloques.pregunta: How is the antecedent of a relative in a description with several names determined with total certainty?

opciones.texto: By matching the gender and number of the pronoun relative to the previous nouns in the main sentence.
opciones.explicacion: The gender flexion and pronoun number unambiguously links the one relative to its antecedent.

opciones.texto: Assuming that the relative always invariably describes the first noun of prayer.
opciones.explicacion: The relative is usually placed as close as possible to its reference core, which is not always the first.

opciones.texto: By mechanically translating the phrase by «that» without attending to German grammatical articles.
opciones.explicacion: Allowing the bending prevents distinguishing between masculine, feminine and contiguous neutral backgrounds.

bloques.frase: die Akte, in der wichtige Daten fehlen
bloques.traduccion: the file in which important data are missing
bloques.explicacion: feminine «die Akte», «in» preposition with static locative dative («in der») and verb at the end.

bloques.pregunta: Choose the complex prayer that resolves the reference without any case or gender failure:

opciones.texto: Die Richterin las die Urkunde, in der die genauen Besitzverhältnisse beschrieben wurden.
opciones.explicacion: feminine («die Urkunde») antecedent, «in» + dative locative preposition («in der») and passive verb at the end.

opciones.texto: Die Richterin las die Urkunde, in dem die genauen Besitzverhältnisse beschrieben wurden.
opciones.explicacion: Make a mistake when using neutral «in dem» to refer to a feminine noun.

opciones.texto: Die Richterin las die Urkunde, in der wurden die genauen Besitzverhältnisse beschrieben.
opciones.explicacion: It breaks the subordinate order by placing the auxiliary verb in third position instead of at the end.

intro: In descriptive texts, expert reports and professional profiles of level B1.2, it is essential to channel relative complex prayers by accurately identifying the antecedent to avoid lexic reference ambiguities and grammatical gender.
